'''Halle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Acherin]] who was married to [[Alder]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when Acherin joined sides with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Halle, along with her husband and many civilians refused to support the Separatists and fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, when the war ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Republic was reorganized into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the rule of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Halla and the people of Acherin fought against the Empire which led to a civil war.

In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Halle and her husband were visited by [[Clive Flax]] when he arrived on the planet after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], looking for information on the rebel known as [[Eve Yarrow|Flame]]. Saying at first that he was looking for Alder's sister, [[Vira]], who had died in the fighting that engulfed the planet's population, he gained their trust. Halle told Clive what she knew about Flame, whom she believed had grown up in the city of [[Sood]].
